authorization: User directed a VBench-first restart of the experiment plan; this file registers no CPU/GPU job.

supersedes_future_requirements.scope: v3 prospective quotas and global unused-source eligibility only; frozen bundles remain unchanged

role_policy.group_unit: original image or verified larger near-duplicate/source cluster; all prompts/crops/seeds share one role
role_policy.legacy_arms: report separately; if old fit ancestors overlap current DEV/eval, do not call that arm source-heldout

selection.policy: Within each official category, ascending lowercase hexadecimal SHA256 of literal seed + | + exact image_name; first=CAL_A, second=CAL_B, third=DEV
selection.input_only_replacement: Before new output inspection, unreadable/mismatched/duplicate inputs advance to next hash-ranked image in the same category; version and record the reason
selection.category_labels: Keep official labels, including taxonomic oddities; optional content tags do not rewrite official membership

recipe.offload: same LightX2V block-offload setting in all arms

sampling.shared_across: all four steps, all forty layers, and compared arms within source x generation seed
sampling.data_dependent_fit_inputs: Every fit configuration may read only its own source subset x row prefix, including Q1 alpha, P/Q, normalization, initialization and regularization scales; no wider-row or larger-source learned statistics.
sampling.loss_normalization: Mean over sources and mean over each source rows; hold model family and regularization policy fixed for the data-allocation table.

inference.reason: One DEV source per category provides no within-category resampling variance.
inference.local_primary_aggregation: M(c,e,m): equal mean over prespecified layers of gated SSE/(actual uniform rows*5120). r=(M_m-M_currentQ1)/M_currentQ1. Equal mean of high/low r within source, then equal mean over the 11 DEV sources. Separate six-site and all80 tables.
inference.secondary_aggregation: Preserve absolute risks and ratio of mean risks as secondary tables; do not switch the primary after seeing outcomes.
inference.small_denominator: Use a measurable floor fixed from CAL neutral numerical error; preserve absolute risk, flag relative effect unmeasurable, retain the source and mark affected primary conclusion inconclusive.
inference.timing_aggregation: Per-source log(candidate/currentQ1 production time), then equal source mean; first pass is exploratory, technical replication and interval policy separately frozen.

dev_official_base_condition_applicabilit.additional_diagnostics: RAFT and visual checks report their own observed coverage

representation_controls.endpoint_nonlinear: P32/Q32; linear32 + tanh32 readout features; matched delta nonlinear control
representation_controls.conditional_capacity_control: Required before promoting endpoint N on the basis of N>L32, even if N also beats delta-N; same-bank L64/Q32, matched readout parameter count.
representation_controls.symmetry: Zero displacement produces zero correction; reversing endpoints changes sign. Scale-only CAL feature normalization, no offset in delta features; validate actual BF16 path.
representation_controls.required_capacity_control_before_promoti: If N>L32 is a reason to promote N, require L64/Q32 on the same bank even if N also beats delta-N; no new generation.
